title: Greg Capullo
description: "l thought Han's torture scene would be cool 'cause I could draw teeth and spittle!!" says Greg Capullo with a mischievous glint in his eye. Capullo's first pro-commission was for Marvel's WHAT IF? (Issue #2). After a few one-shots he began his first full-time book, QUASER. Capullo rode the starways from issues until the "great exodus" after which he landed an enjoyable Issue year-long stay on X-FORCE. marked his departure to Image Comics, where he's completed three "amazingly fun" issues of Todd McFarlane's SPAWN.
